SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.

6. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.

   C. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.

8. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   C. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat School and Community as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

13. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   C. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

14. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   C. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
